name: Chakma
note: Biju is an important New Year festival; the Chakma language has its own script.

name: Marma
note: Sangrai is a major festival; Marma language and weaving traditions are important cultural features.

name: Tripura
note: Kokborok (also written Kokbarak or Tipra in references) is an important community language. Tripura communities live in several hill districts.

name: Mro
note: A hill community with a distinct language and cultural traditions; often called Murong in older references.

name: Tanchangya
note: A distinct community with its own language and Bisu New Year traditions.

name: Bawm
note: A hill community with distinct language and textile traditions.

name: Khumi
note: A community associated with the southern Chittagong Hill Tracts.

name: Khyang
note: A distinct hill community; Khyang and Khumi are different community names.

name: Pankhua
note: A community with its own language and traditions in the Chittagong Hill Tracts.

name: Lushai
note: A community connected with the wider Mizo cultural and linguistic region.

name: Chak
note: A distinct community; Chak and Chakma should not be treated as interchangeable names.

name: Garo / Mandi
note: Matrilineal inheritance and Wangala are important study themes. Mandi and A'chik are community self-designations.

name: Hajong
note: A community of the northern foothill region with its own language and agricultural heritage.

name: Khasi
note: Khasi communities are associated with the northeastern hills; matrilineal descent and betel cultivation are study themes.

name: Manipuri
note: Weaving and dance traditions are important; the label includes diverse linguistic and religious communities.

name: Santal
note: Santali is an Austroasiatic language; Sohrai and Baha are important festival traditions.

name: Oraon
note: Kurukh is a Dravidian language. Oraon and Santal are distinct communities.

name: Rakhine
note: Coastal Rakhine communities have distinctive Buddhist, linguistic and weaving traditions.

name: Munda
note: Munda communities are present in the southwest, including the Sundarbans-adjacent region.

name: Koch
note: A community associated with the northern border and forest regions.
